title: AnyRecon: Arbitrary-View 3D Reconstruction with Video Diffusion
summary: AnyRecon is a framework for high-quality 3D object reconstruction from sparse and unordered sets of photographs. It utilizes a video diffusion model and global scene memory to maintain geometric consistency across arbitrary viewpoints.
research_notes: Leverages the Wan2.1 I2V 14B base model and reports a 10-20x inference speedup compared to previous state-of-the-art baselines.

evolution.summary: Released in early 2026, the project introduced non-compressive latent encoding and visibility-based point cloud memory to solve structural blurriness in sparse-view 3D reconstruction.
